title: Reciprocal cutoff for the direct 3D Coulomb construction

out_librpa_3d_direct_ecut.meaning: Reciprocal cutoff in Ry for out_librpa_3d_coulomb_method=direct_reciprocal; must be converged for each auxiliary basis.

constraints: Must be positive when direct_reciprocal is selected.
Convergence is auxiliary-basis specific; do not copy a value between different ABFS sets.
